title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E9 — Vietnamese Cuisine
Martha creates an incredible Vietnamese feast with her friend Monica Tran, including lettuce-wrapped golden fried spring rolls, traditional pho soup, and savory sizzling pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E10 — Sweet and Savory Apple Dishes
Martha makes homemade apple cider, a tender pork roast with apples and braised red cabbage; and of course, we can't have an apple show without dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Chicken Dinner
Martha serves up a delicious chicken dinner with fresh ingredients from her greenhouse; joined by her good friend Kevin Sharkey, they celebrate the perfect meal for a taste of home-cooked goodness.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E3 — Pizza Perfection: Sicilian and Neapolitan-Style Pizzas
Martha serves up delicious homemade pizzas alongside friends and pizza chefs Christian Petroni and Dean Medico; featuring classic pizzas, signature sauces, and more.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E10 — Braising
Which cuts of meat are good for braising; classic pot roast; braised cabbage with apples; pulled pork sandwiches.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E12 — Frying
French fries; pan-fried chicken; Japanese tempura vegetables with dipping sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E13 — Pan Searing
Pan-seared scallops with lemon-caper sauce; crisp-skinned salmon filet; pan-seared steak with mustard-cream sauce; Muscovy duck breasts with port wine reduction.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Roast
Rib roast; crown roast of pork; stuffed turkey breast; the best cuts for roasting.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E2 — Stewing
The basic elements of making a stew; beef stew; veal stew; coq au vin.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E3 — Soups
Homemade chicken soup; minestrone; velouté.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E4 — Vegetables
Blanching, steaming and roasting vegetables.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E10 — Focaccia and Pizza
Oven-dried heirloom tomato pizza; grape focaccia; thin tarte flambée; three-cheese gluten-free calzone.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E9 — Basic Breads
White, multigrain and rye breads; Parker House rolls.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E1 — Old-Fashioned Fruit Desserts
Peach cobbler; blueberry crisp; blackberry buckle; pear brown Betty.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E2 — Breakfast
Dutch baby pancake; oven-baked French toast; quiche made with peas and ham; cheese, ham and onion strata.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E6 — Pies
Peach crumble pie; key lime pie baked in a Graham cracker crust; coconut cream pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E8 — Cupcakes
Four cupcake recipes: blueberry swirl, lemon meringue, red velvet with cream cheese frosting, and one-bite double Diablo.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E13 — Muffins
Giant bran muffins filled with raisins; citrusy mini orange muffins; healthy morning muffins; plum-filled coffee cake muffins; glazed zucchini muffins.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E6 — How to Make Croissants and Sourdough Bread
Martha journeys through her local area in search of the ultimate fresh-baked croissants and sourdough bread; learning about homemade bread and pastries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E8 — Martha Throws a Tea Party
Martha and her niece Sophie visit their favorite tea shop, Arogya, in Westport, Conn., to discover the dos and don'ts of making tea; they return to Martha's kitchen to create dishes with tea.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E9 — Martha and the Chocolate Factory
Martha visits Mast Market in Mt. Kisco, N.Y., and learns the art behind making their renowned chocolate; from roasting cacao, to stone grinding, to forming delicious bars and chips.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E4 — Picture Perfect Rolled Lasagna
Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E5 — Easy Homemade Dumplings
Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E24 — City Bakery (Field Trip); Seat Cover
Making seat covers; painting tips; tart recipes.
